error_gates.U_ref_definition: U_ref=analytic free-surface speed=1.5*ubar; all velocity gates and Mach use case-specific U_ref
error_gates.flux_definition: q_prime=integral_0^h u(n)dn [m^2/s per unit span]; Q=Ly*q_prime [m^3/s]
error_gates.hard_failure_policy: fixed denominator, no threshold relaxation, no same-input retry
error_gates.pressure_reference: p(n)=p_atm+rho*g_n_abs*(h-n), g_n_abs=g*cos(theta); gravity dot normal is -g_n_abs
error_gates.profile_l2_normalization: L2 error divided by max(L2 analytic profile,1e-12)
error_gates.reference_profile: 64 fixed midpoint samples n_j=(j+0.5)*h/64; particle velocities interpolated/averaged in local (s,n) coordinates
error_gates.reference_time_window: tau=h^2/nu=0.9 s; discard [0,3*tau); average diagnostics over [3*tau,5*tau] at fixed TimeOut
error_gates.steady_window_and_denominator: same theta, same physical window, same fixed sample count for fine/production comparisons
error_gates.surface_height_reference: local normal coordinate n after subtracting theoretical plane n=h and time-window mean

mechanism.description: A fully developed single-phase Newtonian film on a fixed inclined plane: tangential gravity drives viscous shear, the bottom is no-slip, and the top is a real free surface with zero tangential stress.
mechanism.name: gravity-driven free-surface viscous film / Nusselt film
mechanism.steady_prediction: u(n)=g_s/nu*(h*n-n^2/2), ubar=g_s*h^2/(3*nu), q_prime=g_s*h^3/(3*nu) [m^2/s per unit span], Q=Ly*q_prime

domain.boundary: periodic streamwise/spanwise with streamwise normal offset; no inlet/outlet

physical_contract.initial_state: fluid at rest, film parallel to fixed inclined plane, no inherited velocity
